subject: general
question: The health component of Human Development Index is measured by the __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**life expectancy at birth.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Life Expectancy at birth** 

 
 
• The **average number of years that a newborn could expect to live if he or she were to pass through life exposed to the sex- and age-specific death rates prevailing at the time of his or her birth, for a specific year, in a given country, territory, or geographic area.**
 
• **Hong Kong has the highest life expectancy.**
 
 
 
• **Human Development Index**
 
 
• The **statistic composite index of life expectancy, education, and per capita income indicators, is used to rank countries into four tiers of human development.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sex ratio**

 
 
• The sex ratio is the** ratio of females to males in a population.**
 
• **Qatar** has the **highest sex ratio, with three males per woman, followed by the United Arab Emirates, having 222 men per 100 women.**
